summary: Ingest (ingest.ai) is a restaurant back-office data platform, founded 2018 and based in New Orleans, Louisiana, that consolidates POS, inventory, vendor, reservation, menu, HR/staffing and bill-payment data into a single reporting and analytics layer. (Scope note: Founding year and location corroborated by CB Insights aggregator profile, not a primary company filing.)

Ingest has raised a total of approximately $6.3M across multiple rounds, with its most recent round (~$3.66M) closed within the prior year of the research date, per CB Insights company financial tracking. (Scope note: Funding figures sourced from a data aggregator, not a primary press release; treat as directionally accurate rather than exact.)

Ingest lists a direct integration with Resy (reservation data) among its restaurant-system integrations, consistent with its back-office/BI positioning that pulls from POS, reservations, and other operational systems into one dashboard.
